Name: Stoner Valley
Author: BongWaterrr
Description:
[size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b]If you add this mod to an existing save file, you [b]MUST [/b]sleep one night before all features become available. Starting a new save is recommended as it will grant access to every nook and cranny this mod adds (i.e. letters in the mail, certain things being locked behind dates, etc), however it works perfectly fine with existing saves (as long as you sleep one day after adding it!). [/size]

[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]7 strains of weed to grow, including one during winter. (more planned for the future!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]7 new THC-infused cooking recipes.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]4 new machines.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]4 new artisan goods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Process your weed into blunts, package it into jars, concentrate it into a fine wax, or melt it down into cannabutter.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]New location in the mountains to purchase cannabis seeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]A new NPC, Bizz! You can buy the new seeds from his trailer once the railroad has been unlocked.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Gift your weed and weed products to villagers. [/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Sell your products for high profit![/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Powerful end-game item available to purchase at the trailer after adding Leo to your friends list.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size][/*]
[/list]
